description: Reconstructed captures exclude repeated named rules over one original span despite distinct synthetic spans (engine §4 and §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (X [+T])
%rule b (X [+T] [+U])
%rule c $x:r %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(rival)

%rule r (r T) | X
%rule rival (X [+T])
